text: I see you are experiencing fatigue and difficulty concentrating; to better understand your condition, have you noticed any unexplained weight loss, fever, or night sweats recently? Also, please describe any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns over the past few weeks.

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the digital pain improving with cold is very suggestive of Raynaud's phenomenon. Have you noticed any recent changes in your urine color, such as it appearing dark or tea-colored, and have you had any joint pain? REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, peripheral blood smear, urinalysis, and ANA panel.
